description: Sidewalk Centerline is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Boston Maps. City of Boston sidewalk centerline date. Created in 2011 and last updated in 2011. Data consists of sidewalks, privatewalks, and crosswalks. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Boston Maps. Its tags are boston, bparc, ckan, inventory, maps. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2025-08-31 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
